object.name: Poll
object.description: This object contains information about a poll.
object.html_description: This object contains information about a poll.
object.rst_description: This object contains information about a poll.

annotations.name: id
annotations.description: Unique poll identifier
annotations.html_description: Unique poll identifier
annotations.rst_description: Unique poll identifier

annotations.name: question
annotations.description: Poll question, 1-300 characters
annotations.html_description: Poll question, 1-300 characters
annotations.rst_description: Poll question, 1-300 characters

annotations.name: question_entities
annotations.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the question. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll questions
annotations.html_description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the question. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll questions
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Special entities that appear in the *question*. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll questions

annotations.name: options
annotations.description: List of poll options
annotations.html_description: List of poll options
annotations.rst_description: List of poll options

annotations.name: total_voter_count
annotations.description: Total number of users that voted in the poll
annotations.html_description: Total number of users that voted in the poll
annotations.rst_description: Total number of users that voted in the poll

annotations.name: is_closed
annotations.description: True, if the poll is closed
annotations.html_description: True, if the poll is closed
annotations.rst_description: :code:`True`, if the poll is closed

annotations.name: is_anonymous
annotations.description: True, if the poll is anonymous
annotations.html_description: True, if the poll is anonymous
annotations.rst_description: :code:`True`, if the poll is anonymous

annotations.name: type
annotations.description: Poll type, currently can be 'regular' or 'quiz'
annotations.html_description: Poll type, currently can be “regular” or “quiz”
annotations.rst_description: Poll type, currently can be 'regular' or 'quiz'

annotations.name: allows_multiple_answers
annotations.description: True, if the poll allows multiple answers
annotations.html_description: True, if the poll allows multiple answers
annotations.rst_description: :code:`True`, if the poll allows multiple answers

annotations.name: allows_revoting
annotations.description: True, if the poll allows to change the chosen answer options
annotations.html_description: True, if the poll allows to change the chosen answer options
annotations.rst_description: :code:`True`, if the poll allows to change the chosen answer options

annotations.name: members_only
annotations.description: True if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll was originally sent for more than 24 hours
annotations.html_description: True if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll was originally sent for more than 24 hours
annotations.rst_description: :code:`True` if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll was originally sent for more than 24 hours

annotations.name: country_codes
annotations.description: Optional. A list of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll. The country code 'FT' is used for users with anonymous numbers. If omitted, then users from any country can participate in the poll.
annotations.html_description: Optional. A list of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll. The country code “FT” is used for users with anonymous numbers. If omitted, then users from any country can participate in the poll.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. A list of two-letter `ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2>`_ country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll. The country code 'FT' is used for users with anonymous numbers. If omitted, then users from any country can participate in the poll.

annotations.name: correct_option_ids
annotations.description: Optional. Array of 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options. Available only for polls in quiz mode which are closed or were sent (not forwarded) by the bot or to the private chat with the bot.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Array of 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options. Available only for polls in quiz mode which are closed or were sent (not forwarded) by the bot or to the private chat with the bot.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Array of 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options. Available only for polls in quiz mode which are closed or were sent (not forwarded) by the bot or to the private chat with the bot.

annotations.name: explanation
annotations.description: Optional. Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters
annotations.html_description: Optional. Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters

annotations.name: explanation_entities
annotations.description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the explanation
annotations.html_description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the explanation
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the *explanation*

annotations.name: explanation_media
annotations.description: Optional. Media added to the quiz explanation
annotations.html_description: Optional. Media added to the quiz explanation
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Media added to the quiz explanation

annotations.name: open_period
annotations.description: Optional. Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation
annotations.html_description: Optional. Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation

annotations.name: close_date
annotations.description: Optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed
annotations.html_description: Optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed

annotations.name: description
annotations.description: Optional. Description of the poll; for polls inside the Message object only
annotations.html_description: Optional. Description of the poll; for polls inside the Message object only
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Description of the poll; for polls inside the :class:`litegram.types.message.Message` object only

annotations.name: description_entities
annotations.description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description
annotations.html_description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description

annotations.name: media
annotations.description: Optional. Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the Message object only
annotations.html_description: Optional. Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the Message object only
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the :class:`litegram.types.message.Message` object only
